svg.title: The Surplus-to-Resale Engine
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-surplus-to-resale-engine; chapter number: 1; chart type: process_flow; title: The Surplus-to-Resale Engine; subtitle: Buy surplus cheap, verify it, document it, then resell or rerent; caption: Operators converge on one loop. Centurion moves about 6,000 pieces a month and turns its entire inventory every 5 weeks, while the Earn Your Leisure founder rerents returned units on 13-month Medicare rentals.; assumptions note: Step order follows the operator gates and quotes attributed below; no throughput or margin figures beyond those stated by the speakers are implied.; note: Attributed to Centurion Service Group (A TRIMEDX Company), Bill Whittemore, Jon Sheppard Sells, Used Medical Equipment, and Earn Your Leisure.; stages: step: 01; label: Source hospital surplus and trade-ins; value: Step 1; detail: Centurion represents well over 1,000 hospitals, surgery centers and manufacturers and moves about 6,000 pieces a month.; step: 02; label: Recheck with a biomed team; value: Step 2; detail: Bill Whittemore: never ship on a power-on check alone; recheck with biomed or sell it explicitly as is.; step: 03; label: Write condition limits into the listing; value: Step 3; detail: Jon Sheppard Sells: add condition limits and clear pictures before the listing goes live, because returns still hit sellers.; step: 04; label: Display patient-ready inventory; value: Step 4; detail: Used Medical Equipment puts biomed certified, patient-ready equipment on display so doctors can see what is available.; step: 05; label: Resell or rerent the unit; value: Step 5; detail: Earn Your Leisure bills a 13-month rental for most equipment, picks it up when no longer needed, and rerents the same item.

circle.title: step: 01; label: Source hospital surplus and trade-ins; value: Step 1; detail: Centurion represents well over 1,000 hospitals, surgery centers and manufacturers and moves about 6,000 pieces a month.
